author: Govinda Wagle
review_text: Tried to transfer to Linked Bank Account. It was a critical transaction for me and I needed to withdraw from the Bank the very day. It went to Pending status. Reached out to support via Facebook, Viber and Toll free number, informed them about the urgency. By the time I am writing this review it's been almost 4 hours but they have not resolved it yet.

author: Debagya K
review_text: Now eSewa becomes useless. It didn't give the discount on transfer/recharge. There are many Nepali apps which gives discount so better to use other apps. No reason to use eSewa.
